title: Fourth dimensional mall sphere, has anyone else experienced anything like this?

classification.question_topic: Asking if others have experienced a similar 'fourth dimensional' infinite mall-space experience and related motifs

meta.initial_emotion: having fun/hanging out (first half in city)
meta.final_emotion: woke up for real after being 'swallowed by the blackness' of the elevator; overall impression includes 'total peace' about the MallSphere segment
meta.author_theory: Mentions considering what dreams mean for consciousness/universe; notes recurring motifs (gateways, elevators, water, wise woman motif)

position.relative_to: first half of dream takes place in a city; later they find and enter a mall complex somewhere in the city

qualities.raw_description: “We were hanging out and just having fun in some city for the first half.”

locations.location_name: mall complex ("huge malls you'd see in Manhattan")

qualities.raw_description: “this mall complex… huge malls you'd see in Manhattan. There was like a river flowing through the mall complex”

locations.location_name: river flowing through the mall complex

qualities.raw_description: “me and my friends were wading through it as the tide got higher the more we explored the mall.”

locations.location_name: back corners of the mall (luxurious velvety corridors)

position.relative_to: after exiting the river area, explored back corners of the mall

qualities.raw_description: “increasingly eerie… walls and carpets were lined in luxurious velvety colors… like something in a movie theater… like the Red Room in Twin Peaks but more neon… Completely dead empty and silent besides me and my three dream-friends.”

locations.location_name: free-fall through an infinitely expansive "Mall Sphere" of chain stores/aisles/food courts

position.relative_to: the floor of the mall "phases out" and the dreamer is free falling through this space

qualities.raw_description: “free falling, slowly as though submerged in water… through what I can only describe as a… Mall Sphere expanding infinitely in all directions… falling down, up, between and through… infinitely expansive row of chain stores and shopping aisles… a vast nothingness of empty malls and food courts… unbelievably welcoming and pleasant… utter, expansive comfort and bliss in all directions… cocoon of balming contentment.”

position.relative_to: after leaving the MallSphere/that iteration of it, ended up in another corridor

qualities.raw_description: “another corridor… more like a hospital… the scary feeling returned… I was much lower to the ground… like… a medium sized crawling or slithering animal.”

locations.location_name: vast corridor (alone) with open pitch-black elevator

position.relative_to: after running/crawling away from the nurse, alone in a vast corridor; elevator stands open in front

qualities.raw_description: “once again alone in a vast corridor. This time however a pitch black elevator stood open in front of me.”

position.relative_to: entered from the corridor with the open elevator

qualities.raw_description: “I step through and get swallowed by the blackness.”

connections.qualities: “Somewhere in the city we found and entered this mall complex”

interactions.description: Two dream-friends started fighting; one overpowered the other and shoved his face under the water; dreamer jumped in and wrestled to save them.

entities_involved.description: dream-friend overpowering another, pushing face under water
entities_involved.name_or_relation: dream-friend (amalgam of people the dreamer knew)
dream-friend (amalgam of people the dreamer knew)

interactions.description: After the rescue, a friend said the attempted drowning was meant to happen and was 'trying to save each other' and that the dreamer ruined it.

entities_involved.description: tells dreamer the drowning was supposed to happen; implies dreamer interfered

interactions.description: Dreamer feels paranoid that friends are watching from behind and planning retribution for intercepting their 'baptism'.

entities_involved.description: dream-friends perceived as watching from behind shoulder

interactions.description: Dreamer perceives being much lower to the ground than in real life, like a medium sized crawling/slithering animal.
A nurse aggressively pushes a child on a stretcher up the wall; nurse flashes a look of rage at the child; nurse notices the dreamer, scowls, and makes a 'shhh' gesture.

entities_involved.description: nurse; scowls; finger to lips 'shhh'; looks of rage
child on a stretcher being pushed up the wall

interactions.description: Dreamer runs/crawls/slithers away from the nurse after being noticed and shushed.

entities_involved.description: nurse who scowled and shushed the dreamer

interactions.description: Dreamer stands before an open pitch-black elevator; realizes they can't keep from waking; steps through and is swallowed by blackness; then wakes up.

extraction.extraction_notes: Some segments are described as abrupt 'shifts' with no transition; spatial layout is conveyed via relative movement (city -> mall -> river -> back corners -> phasing/fall into MallSphere -> hospital corridor -> vast corridor -> open black elevator). No explicit cardinal directions or floor counts provided.
